vav.translation: n. 希伯来语的第六个字母(亦作waw)

vavasor.definition:
n. The vassal or tenant of a baron; one who held under a
   baron, and who also had tenants under him; one in dignity next to a
   baron; a title of dignity next to a baron.
vavasor.translation: n. [史](中世纪的)封臣(领有封地并有自己的家臣,地位次于男爵)

vavasory.definition:
n. The quality or tenure of the fee held by a vavasor; also,
   the lands held by a vavasor.
vavasory.translation: n. [史]封臣领地, (封臣的)对领地占有使用权

vavasour.translation: n. [史](中世纪的)封臣(领有封地并有自己的家臣,地位次于男爵)

vavuniya.translation: [地名] [斯里兰卡] 瓦武尼亚
